room_identity: Where the outside got in. Stone, dust and growth - the least oppressive room, and the only one with living green.

builder_contract.pivot: Committed pivot and PPU from PropCatalog.json; the builder never recomputes one.
builder_contract.y_is_always_zero: Every placement sits on the floor at y=0. This matters most for the standing guardian: 2.44 drawn against a 2.5 wall is 0.06 units of headroom, about four pixels at 64 PPU, and any lift puts it outside the room. Do not scale it either.
builder_contract.sorting: sorting_order = round((x - z) * 10); larger x-z is nearer the camera.
builder_contract.colliders: The dressing prefab carries NO colliders.
builder_contract.lie_within_props: shared_bone_pile_b is the room's only lie_within entry.

clearance_proved.routes: West and east routes swept every 0.5 units of z: >= 3.0 clear. The east route is 3.75 by construction and the dressing does not eat into it.
clearance_proved.skirts: Every rubble skirt is asserted INSIDE its blocker footprint - spilling past a collider edge is how dressing starts lying about where a blocker is.

the_beat_that_must_not_be_swapped: INTACT guardian WEST, FALLEN guardian EAST, asserted three ways. The player starts at X=-4 and walks north up the wide west lane, meets the intact one first, and sees its fallen twin only at the door. Swapping them throws the room's only reveal away.

props.intent: FALLEN guardian on the EAST bound, seen only at the door. That reveal is the entire beat and it costs two props

INTACT guardian on the WEST bound. The player starts at X=-4 and walks north up the wide west lane, so they meet this one first - the dungeon still presenting itself as guarded. Placed at its ground line with NO vertical offset: it has 0.06 units of headroom under the 2.5 wall, about four pixels, and any lift pokes it over the north wall
the ONE drape, on the drawn north face beside the corner. Its footprint runs along X, which is what a north-facing wall takes
